insert: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੂੰ ਬਹੁਤ ਚੰਗੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਜਾਣ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹੋ
you get to know someone very well
ਜਦੋਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਸਿੱਖਦੇ ਹੋ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਜਾਣ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹੋ
when you learn together you get to know people

notes: cs #813: two USE to replace U01/U03 ('a person', 'that person': untaught 'person'). The first is the seed's own clause with its Punjabi wording; the second follows U02's shape with 'learn' and S0022L02 'people'. One BUILD added ('you get to know people') because only 2 counted.
